pairs.why: The two fans are almost pixel-identical: same smooth matte red pleats, gold ribs, plum pin and wavy blue backdrop. B's creases are a touch crisper, but that is too small to choose on.
The renders are effectively the same: matching pleat shading, rib layout and soft light, with no difference in finish or build.
A is a little brighter and wider, and B has slightly sharper fold edges. Both match the real fan's smooth, simple finish equally well.
A's pleats are slightly larger and softer-lit. Otherwise the shape, color, rib structure and matte finish are the same.
The two are nearly indistinguishable: same build, same red, same soft studio light, no gloss or texture difference.
A's folds are slightly softer and smoother, closer to the real fan's gentle matte pleats, while B's are a hair crisper. The difference is marginal.
Only the background brightness differs slightly. The fans have identical shape, finish and rib construction.
A is a touch paler and softer, B a touch more saturated. Both are smooth and well built, and neither stands out as closer.
